evidence.text: Lakshay Goyal is a Software Engineer building thoughtful mobile and web products.

I moved from Delhi to Bangalore, helped build FOZO from the ground up, and now work on test automation at Testsigma. I care about polished interfaces, understandable systems, and work that lasts beyond a demo.
Building things that make test automation a little less painful. Mostly jumping between backend, frontend, and infra, figuring things out along the way.
Built a food delivery platform from scratch, handling everything from architecture and mobile apps to servers, deployments, and all the chaos in between.
Built an application builder, where anyone can able to generate an web application using a prompt and creativity.
Built an Mobile application builder, where anyone can able to generate an mobile application using a prompt and creativity.
A CFD application for trade on crypto currencies.
A CFD Mobile application for trade on crypto currencies.
MERN Stack, Next.js, Remix, Turborepo, PostgreSQL (Prisma), API Development
Python, FastAPI, Machine Learning, Deep Learning, NLP, Computer Vision, AI Applications, GenAI, AI Agents
